dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Hello, there. It's nice to see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Sweet spot you got here. Thanks for inviting me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Sure do! It's great!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: I'd like to think I'm a flexible guy who can adapt to any environment, never mind one as pleasant as this.

choices.text: Well, the layout is my pride and joy.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: I can tell.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Some people like to go out and have fun. Others prefer to create a comfy space for themselves at home where they can enjoy some peace and quiet.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: People enjoy life in different ways, but both approaches are equally valid.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: You know, this place is real roomy. There are houses and buildings, sure... But, there's also lots of open space...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: You could build a bunch of different areas, each with a unique design. That way, it'd feel like we were camping in a new place every night!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: I'd even help out if you wanted!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Truth is, I'm fully furnished with ideas as we speak!

choices.text: This is rather embarrassing. I've neglected the place lately...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: No, no, no! Don't say that!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: I prefer being out adventuring too, so I try to keep things simple at home. But even then, my pad isn't nearly as neat as this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Yeah, sure, let's do it! Things were getting quiet around here, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Just as well. There's something I wanted to ask. In your experience, what preparations would I need to make before visiting a newly excavated desert ruin?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you find something?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Not yet. This question's purely hypothetical.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Most of the members of the Temple of Silence spend their time at our base, researching and watching over our ancient technologies. But, there are times when we must investigate external locations.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: I try not to miss out on those opportunities.

choices.text: I don't go to the desert often. You probably have more experience than me.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Really? Was my intel wrong, then?

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: You know, so much of the desert remains a mystery, even to people who've lived there a long time.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Sometimes, we find our path blocked by a bunch of mechanisms before we can even get inside the ruin.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Take the area around the Mausoleum of King Deshret, for example.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: That area has the highest concentration of ruins related to King Deshret. It's also where investigation teams are liable to encounter the most trouble.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: It looks like nothing more than a swath of empty desert, but it's packed to the gills with invisible walls.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: We spent enormous amounts of effort to uncover the expanse of the ruins, only to then discover that determining their height was the real issue.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Later on, a team member suggested bringing some of that invisible material back with us...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: And using it to build an invisible labyrinth around the Temple of Silence to ward off intruders.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're not talking about yourself, are you?

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Hey, do I seem like that sorta person to you?

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: But, I'll admit, we were thinking along the same lines.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: It's just... I wasn't sure our people could navigate a labyrinth like that, so I didn't bring it up.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: In the end, my concerns turned out to be valid, and we scratched the idea.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Allow me to thank you on behalf of all adventurers everywhere.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Haha, don't mention it!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Even if you don't count that labyrinth, I can assure you that the desert's not hurting for mysteries.

choices.text: I know the desert like the back of my hand.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Haha, that's the "experienced adventurer" aura I expected. So, are you familiar with the differences in climate between various regions in the desert, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Oh, you bet I do. A whole list!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: But, I didn't want to step on your toes, seeing as this is your place and all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wh—What were you considering?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Um, that maybe... we could... build a campsite?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds nice.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: R—Really? Awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Let me see... First, we'll need at least two tents.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: First one's for resting. We'll put thick cloth up around the walls to keep any noise out.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: We could even use that one for research or to organize our documents.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: The other tent will be a space to chat and play games. We can put picnic supplies and chairs near the entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: The weather here seems pretty nice, so we shouldn't need any rain or wind protection...

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Then, I guess the only thing left would be adding some adventure to this place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: No matter how beautiful the scenery, standing back and looking at it's gonna get old sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: You've got to get out there and enjoy it!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: And if there were mechanisms that we could use to jump, run, climb, or glide around this place, that would be the cherry on top!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Install stuff like that, and whoosh! Nothing here would be off-limits.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I could ask Tubby about that.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Ah, you mean that little finch with the nice smile?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Perfect! I've actually talked to her already. All that stuff she knows about housekeeping... Super impressive!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: I couldn't get her to tell me about all of her contraptions, but I understand. Every organization has its secrets... The Temple of Silence is like that too.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I'll find a way.

choices.text: Turning this into an amusement park, are we?

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Perfect! Glad to have your stamp of approval!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Well, I'll get designing, then. I'll let you know when the blueprints are ready.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: You can invite your other friends over once it's done. The more, the merrier!

choices.text: Whatever makes you happy. I've got more than enough space.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Sethos.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Morning! Today's a new day!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think... Should I scout out a new hiking route or just find somewhere to camp nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Sethos.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Good night! Hey, you're up pretty late. Still got plans, then?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: I'm not tired either. How about we go out for a bit? If we run into trouble, I'll protect you! Or, you can protect me... whatever works!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Whenever I go to the Grand Bazaar, I head straight to the food stalls, grab some snacks and a drink, and then I take my time checking the place out.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: But, some shops are off-limits if you have your hands full... A carpet shop, for example.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: How about this... We split the snacks! That way, we can finish them off quickly and then get shopping!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Wow, wow, wow, you've got yourself a pro-grade grill right there. Temperature, rotation speed... It all looks pitch-perfect!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Ah, I've got it!

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: How about we use these spices, grill up some steaks, and stuff 'em in a wrap?
